the development and implementation of a numerical modeling and computation technique for synthesizing A-scan signals from pipelines.
the development and implementation of a synthetic technique for the generation of A-scan signals for ultrasonic testing (UT) of pipes and pipelines.
the development of an efficient, accurate, and robust synthetic A-scan method for ultrasonic testing.
